name: trust-documents
title: Trust documents
description: The documents a security review asks for, each with its date and size, as a download or a request that opens a short form and calls your handler.
docs: Pass documents (an id, a title, a line about it, the format, the size, the date it applies to, access as public or request, and the href of a public file) and onRequest, called with the document id and the checked details (email and company) when someone asks for one. Resolve it to confirm; reject it to show an error that keeps everything typed. A public document is a real download link whose name carries the title, the type and the size; one on request is marked in words and opens a dialog that checks a work email and a company, confirms with a focused status message, and afterwards reads Requested. A request in flight cannot be closed away, so its failure is never lost, and on a short screen the dialog keeps a margin and scrolls inside itself, so its title and the retry button can always be reached. On a wide block the date and the size get a column of their own. Nothing is sent or stored by the block. Use contact for the line under the list and the fallback in the error, locale and timeZone for the dates, and labels to translate every word, error messages included.
